trigger.teacherContext: DiffLocks generates explicit 3D strands from a single frontal image using a learned diffusion prior.
trigger.observation: A front projection cannot constrain depth or fully occluded backside geometry. Multiple materially different strand sets can produce the exact same front projection.
trigger.failureMechanism: A plausible learned prior can be silently promoted from INFERRED/OCCLUDED to REFERENCE_MATCH or CURRENT_TRUTH, turning single-view reconstruction into an unauthorized creative substitute.

deduplication.issue91Search: No existing #91 case found that binds single-view hair reconstruction to per-region observed-versus-inferred provenance and withheld-view evidence.
deduplication.defaultBranchCodeSearch: No matching single-view occluded-hair provenance regression found on main.
deduplication.existingPolicy: REFERENCE_REPLICATION_NO_CREATIVE_SUBSTITUTE_GATE already requires UNKNOWN/OCCLUDED and forbids unapproved inferred hidden surfaces; this Candidate is a domain-specific executable regression, not a new global principle.

verifierGate.when: taskMode=REPLICATION_LOCKED and any generated 3D region is not directly constrained by the referenceViewSet
hardFail: An INFERRED_PRIOR_CANDIDATE or OCCLUDED_UNKNOWN region is labeled REFERENCE_MATCH, CURRENT_TRUTH, FROZEN, ACCEPTED_BASELINE, or USER_ACCEPTED without new evidence or explicit user authorization.
A front-only match is used as proof of backside or depth correctness.
Repeated output from one fixed seed is used as proof that occluded geometry is uniquely determined or correct.
The candidate silently falls back to a model prior while receipt claims exact replication.
hold: Occluded geometry is disclosed as INFERRED_PRIOR_CANDIDATE but no independent side/back/scan evidence exists.
Only one diffusion sample was inspected for a truth claim over an ambiguous occluded region.
A multi-seed ensemble exposes occluded variation but no external evidence selects a reference-bound hypothesis.
The reference coverage mask or per-region evidence classification is missing.
Withheld views exist but were not run against the exact candidate subject.
passRequires: every visible and occluded region has an evidence class
front-only evidence is scoped only to front-observable claims
occluded regions remain OCCLUDED_UNKNOWN or INFERRED_PRIOR_CANDIDATE unless additional evidence constrains them
fixed-seed repeatability is recorded separately from truth certainty
when uncertaintyAuditRequired=true, multiple declared seeds quantify observed-versus-occluded variation without promoting any sample by popularity
any REFERENCE_MATCH promotion is supported by side/back/multiview/scan evidence or an explicit approved constraint
an independent verifier checks the exact candidate and source-view set

controls.syntheticNegative: Three 328-point strand sets share the exact same front projection hash, while two priors differ from reference by 50.546 mm and 37.910 mm RMS in the marked occluded region.
controls.singleSeedNegative: Repeating seed 5 three times gives the same full-geometry hash and passes a deterministic runtime gate, while seven distinct seeds preserve one front hash but produce seven different side hashes and 7.556 mm occluded-region ensemble standard deviation.
controls.frontOnlyControl: A naive front-projection gate accepts both different priors; the provenance-aware gate rejects truth promotion and holds a disclosed prior.
controls.multiviewPositive: A side reference exposes the depth difference; a candidate may pass only when the exact side projection also matches and occluded regions are labeled REFERENCE_MATCH.

scopeBoundary: Does not prove DiffLocks or any specific model always generates incorrect backside hair.
Does not prohibit learned priors for exploration or initialization when they are explicitly labeled and isolated from accepted reference truth.
Does not establish a production fidelity threshold, model quality, hardware behavior, or user acceptance.
Applies to truth/provenance claims, not to creative tasks where the user explicitly authorizes hidden-surface design.

evidenceUpdates.finding: DiffLocks pins Torch, NumPy and Python random seeds to 5 and emits one sample per invocation. The author confirms seed-dependent stochasticity. A fixed seed improves replayability but does not establish epistemic certainty for occluded geometry.
